name: Мат ферзем і слоном
description:
The queen and the bishop are a powerful pair for checkmating. In this lesson, you will learn how they work together to make checkmate.

Study the examples to find out how it works.

 

What do you have to do?

Checkmate the king with your queen and bishop.

examples.text: This is a checkmate from close by. The queen attacks the king. And the bishop protects the queen.
This is a mate from a distance. In this position, the bishop does not have to protect the queen, but takes an important flight square from the king.
The roles of the bishop and the queen are reversed here. Now the bishop attacks the king and the queen removes the king's flight squares.

texts: Checkmate in 1 move! Use the power of your bishop and queen.
